name: print-social-teal-headline-post-with-vertical-glass-strips
title: Teal post with a smiling man in profile seen through vertical translucent glass strips
whatItIs: A square post in deep teal with a photo of a man looking up and smiling, overlaid by vertical translucent teal strips of varying opacity like fluted glass, a bold white 'HEADLINE HERE' and short text blocks on the left.
whatItMeans: Calm and optimistic; the strips give depth and a sense of looking through glass.
techniques: Overlay vertical strips of varying opacity.
Tint the whole image in one hue.
Leave the face clear between strips.

vocabulary.definition: Ribbed glass that distorts in vertical bands.
A single-colour wash over a photo.
